title: Trump’s latest land grab is an AI hub in the Philippines
slides: Can Trump turn a Philippine land grab into AI leverage?
The site sits on a former US military base
Locals say the land was taken without consent
Firms sourcing AI compute there face scrutiny
Ask who really owns the land beneath your cloud
thread_text:
1. Land grab or leverage?

The site sits on a former US military base in the Philippines. Now it's at the center of an AI compute controversy involving Trump.

2. Base turned cloud hub

The land was taken from locals without consent, they say. The same land now hosts AI infrastructure that firms rely on.

3. Firms under scrutiny

Companies sourcing AI compute from this site face questions about the land's origins. Investors and regulators are starting to ask.

4. Who owns the ground?

The cloud is physical. Every server sits on land with a history. Ignoring that history is a risk for any AI firm.

5. Ask before you deploy

Before your next AI project, trace the land beneath your cloud provider. Do you know whose land it is?
